answer_1.quote: Argument generation is an essential task in natural language processing with wide applications, such as debates and essay writing.

answer_2.quote: We employ both automatic and human evaluations in our experiments.

answer_3.quote: we propose a LLM-based counterargument evaluation method leveraging GPT-4 (OpenAI, 2023) to judge the outputs.
methods: LLM-based evaluation with scoring on a scale of 1 to 5

answer_4.quote: we hire three proficient English speakers as judges to evaluate output quality.
answer_4.guideline: judges are asked to rank the outputs according to each aspect: Appropriateness, Content Richness, and Overall Quality. They also identify Valid counterarguments of high quality.
